title: Make the VIXEN kernel-pin train regenerate every current-kernel consumer
body: Moving the tracked kernel pin to 6fbd88b59 required manual ordered repair across ExposureTonemap, FrameTargets, recipe SIMD/GLSL/dispatch, callables, the MaterialColor namespace, and UndertowBodies typed output because no single documented VIXEN target regenerated and validated all committed consumers. Add one pin-train target that stages the catalogue, regenerates every committed surface in dependency order, and fails on drift.

title: Land fixed scalar runtime-bucket support before dispatching VIXEN follow-up consumers
body: The b195a5a1 row reached the current kernel generator but failed because RuntimeState ExposureMeterState.histogram is uint with a text bucket. The row was authored against unlanded fixed-scalar/composition support and had to be reverted. Make the prerequisite explicit in the row contract or provide the scalar-bucket declaration on kernel main before redispatch.

title: Preserve shared render-bridge prerequisites across train merge and revert history
body: Merging lane-aataa after the reverted vixfollow merge suppressed shared ancestor changes: generic GPU-system CMake wiring, GeneratedSystemStage, runner lifecycle ownership, ExposureMeterState, generated schedule/manifest and typed imports all had to be restored manually before regeneration could pass. Encode prerequisite closure in the train row or provide a generated merge audit that reports missing shared surfaces.

title: Make node cleanup-scope migrations update dependent node implementations
body: The nodehooks row removed the cleanup context reason field, but SamplerNode still used ctx.reason and made the aggregate build red. I manually moved sampler destruction from TypedCleanupImpl to TypedDeviceReleaseImpl. Generate or statically validate lifecycle overrides so API-scope migrations enumerate every dependent node.

title: Declare borrowed versus owned Vulkan pipeline-cache handles in the UI cache contract
body: The UI-cache row added a separately owned ui-pipelines cache while the current tree already passed the device-wide graphics cache into VixenRmlRenderInterface, producing a duplicate member and ambiguous destruction. I manually added borrowed-or-owned fallback semantics. The cache provider boundary should expose ownership in its type or API so rows compose without hand lifetime reconciliation.

title: Align VIXEN lane build instructions with build-wsl wrapper syntax
body: The documented lane form build-wsl.sh Release all reached cmake --build and failed with Unknown argument Release. The working queued recovery was build-wsl.sh --config Release --target all. Make the dispatch template and wrapper accept the same configuration syntax, or reject positional forms before a full reconfigure.

title: Make direct VIXEN GPU regeneration discover the Undertow catalogue root
body: The first direct row regeneration failed because UNDERTOW_ROOT was absent; recovery required explicitly exporting /home/liory/projects/undertow/.claude-worktrees/vixtrain7, then further manual schema staging. Reuse the configure-time discovered catalogue/root contract for direct generator targets so train lanes do not have to provision it by hand.
